statement: On learning that personal information has been leaked, a controller must notify affected data subjects of the statutory particulars, with the Enforcement Decree setting the window at 72 hours in writing or equivalent means (Personal Information Protection Act Article 34(1); Enforcement Decree Article 39(1)). Where the leak covers 1,000 or more data subjects, sensitive or unique identification information, or resulted from unlawful external access to the processing systems, the controller must also report the same particulars within 72 hours to the Personal Information Protection Commission or the Korea Internet & Security Agency (Act Article 34(4); Decree Article 40(1), (3)).
caveat: Both 72-hour clocks carry narrow statutory outs (urgent containment measures, force majeure), with the duty then due immediately after the cause clears; 30-day public posting can substitute where subject contacts are unknown, and the report may be skipped where recovery or deletion has made rights infringement markedly unlikely. The Act and Decree were amended in force September 11, 2026; verify the live text.
